headline: Rare Mego Green Goblin SMASHES Auction Estimates!
post:
Spider-Man fans, get ready for some wild vintage toy news. According to ComicBook.com, a rare 1975 graded Mego Green Goblin action figure has already "blown past hakes price estimates" with weeks left in the bidding. Originally expected to finish between $30,000 and $50,000, this amazing collectible has already reached a staggering $90,000! 🕷️

This piece is exceptionally rare. It is one of only two graded samples of this specific carded villain, and it has an AFA certified 80+ Near Mint condition. The previous high sale for this item was $76,700 back in 2022, but this current auction has already shattered that record. Experts believe it is "poised to be the first-ever Mego action figure to sell for more than $100k."

Who is your favorite Mego action figure?

#SpiderMan #GreenGoblin #VintageToys
original_title: Record-Breaking Mego Green Goblin Has Already Blown Past Hakes Price Estimates (And There’s Still Weeks Left to Bid)

headline: Frank Miller's accidental Daredevil icon
post:
Did you know that one of the most important supporting characters in the Man Without Fear's history was never meant to stay? According to /Film, writer and artist Frank Miller originally created Elektra Natchios as a temporary addition, explaining in a 1983 discussion that he had a character who "was only supposed to appear for an issue take over the series on me." 🥷

Miller debuted the sai-wielding assassin in 1980's "Daredevil" #168 while taking over the struggling comic book title. Drawing inspiration from classic film noir tropes, he wanted to introduce a unique love interest who could leap across rooftops alongside the hero. Even though her creator initially viewed the assignment as just a few fill-in writing issues, the deadly ninja quickly evolved past those temporary plans.

Today, the legendary assassin remains a massive part of the hero's legacy across comics and live-action adaptations, proving that some creations simply refuse to stay in the shadows. What is your absolute favorite storyline featuring this iconic martial artist? 

#Daredevil #Elektra #MarvelComics
original_title: One Of Daredevil's Most Important Characters Was Only Supposed To Appear Once
